summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE equity made before Firstock has answered the login: the subscribe waits for the answer (audit FB-01), then a V1 full tick and a V1 partial tick merged over it become Quote frames; after the unsubscribe a tick still in flight reaches nobody.

notes: Prices are paise; both divide by 100. The partial tick's zero open price never overwrites the snapshot, on the web (firstock_adapter.py:655-680) and the desktop (brokers/firstock/streaming.rs merge).

Audit FB-01, fixed: FirstockFeed waits for {"status":"success"} before it subscribes, as the web's client queues subscriptions until that answer (firstock_websocket.py:498-505, _process_pending_subscriptions). The script shows it: no frame reaches Firstock before the login push.

deviations.reason: Firstock's i_last_trade_time is in epoch seconds and the web sends it unchanged as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in ms.

The web's Quote sends oi 0 for an equity whose tick carries no open interest (data.get("i_open_interest", 0)); a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md, web openalgo#2376). The desktop's Quote leaves it out.
